_comment: Weekly question-bank scraper sources. Enable a source by setting "enabled": true. The workflow runs every Monday 03:00 UTC (edit .github/workflows/scrape-weekly.yml for frequency). Everything scraped lands as DRAFT in the Admin → Question bank → review & publish. Types: "json" (array or {questions|items|data: [...]}), "html", "markdown" (marker-based: `N. ### Q` + answer body, `#### Topic` + question sentence, or line-based `?` fallback).

sources.note: Design-pattern, architecture and language questions for backend engineers. Question = `#### Topic` heading + question sentence.
Curated JavaScript Q&A bank (`1. ### Question` + model-answer body).
Curated React Q&A bank (`1. ### Question` + model-answer body).
Data-science theory questions (ML, stats, validation). Line-based `?` extraction; difficulty emoji stripped.
